mapper.sql: jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN ${v} IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(${v}) NOT IN ('array', 'string') OR ${v} = '[]'::jsonb THEN '[""]'::jsonb WHEN jsonb_typeof(${v}) = 'array' THEN ${v} ELSE jsonb_build_array(${v}) END)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND relation_type = 'INJECTS'
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_symbol SET layer = NULL, layer_confidence = NULL WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND layer IS NOT NULL
UPDATE analysis_method SET proxy_related = FALSE WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND proxy_related
mapper.insert: WITH mapping AS ( SELECT a.target_kind, a.target_id, a.annotation_name, a.file_id, a.line_start , COALESCE(a.attributes_json->'value', a.attributes_json->'path') AS paths , a.attributes_json->'method' AS methods FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.annotation_name IN ('RequestMapping', 'GetMapping', 'PostMapping', 'PutMapping', 'DeleteMapping', 'PatchMapping') ) INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, http_method, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'HTTP', hm.name , CASE WHEN joined.path = '/' THEN '/' ELSE regexp_replace(joined.path, '/$', '') END , m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('annotation', mm.annotation_name) , mm.file_id, mm.line_start FROM mapping mm JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = mm.target_id LEFT JOIN mapping cm ON cm.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND cm.target_id = m.owner_symbol_id AND cm.annotation_name = 'RequestMapping' CROSS JOIN LATERAL AS cp(path) CROSS JOIN LATERAL AS mp(path) CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE mm.annotation_name WHEN 'GetMapping' THEN 'GET' WHEN 'PostMapping' THEN 'POST' WHEN 'PutMapping' THEN 'PUT' WHEN 'DeleteMapping' THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'PATCH' END AS name WHERE mm.annotation_name <> 'RequestMapping' UNION ALL -- @RequestMapping(method = RequestMethod.GET) 의 GET. 적지 않았으면 모든 메소드를 받는다(ALL). SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(e.text, '^.*\.', ''), ''), 'ALL') FROM AS e(text) WHERE mm.annotation_name = 'RequestMapping' ) hm CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT regexp_replace('/' || cp.path || '/' || mp.path, '/+', '/', 'g') AS path) joined WHERE mm.target_kind = 'METHOD'

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'SCHEDULED' , COALESCE(a.attributes_json->>'cron', a.attributes_json->>'fixedRate', a.attributes_json->>'fixedDelay' , a.attributes_json->>'fixedRateString', a.attributes_json->>'fixedDelayString') , m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id, a.attributes_json, a.file_id, a.line_start FROM analysis_annotation a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = a.revision_id AND m.method_id = a.target_id WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND a.annotation_name = 'Scheduled'

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'LISTENER' , COALESCE(a.attributes_json->>'topics', a.attributes_json->>'queues', a.attributes_json->>'destination', a.attributes_json->>'value') , m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('annotation', a.annotation_name) || a.attributes_json , a.file_id, a.line_start FROM analysis_annotation a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = a.revision_id AND m.method_id = a.target_id WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND a.annotation_name IN ('KafkaListener', 'RabbitListener', 'JmsListener', 'SqsListener', 'StreamListener', 'EventListener', 'TransactionalEventListener')

INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, to_external , confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.field_id) #{revisionId}, 'TYPE', f.owner_symbol_id, 'INJECTS', r.to_kind, r.to_id, r.to_external , r.confidence, r.resolution_status , jsonb_build_object('field', f.name, 'annotation', a.annotation_name) , f.file_id, f.line_start FROM analysis_annotation a JOIN analysis_field f ON f.revision_id = a.revision_id AND f.field_id = a.target_id JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = a.revision_id AND r.from_id = f.field_id AND r.relation_type = 'USES_TYPE' WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = 'FIELD' AND a.annotation_name IN ('Autowired', 'Inject', 'Resource') ORDER BY f.field_id, r.relation_id
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_method m SET proxy_related = TRUE WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT m.is_constructor AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = m.revision_id AND a.annotation_name IN ('Transactional', 'Async', 'Cacheable', 'CacheEvict', 'CachePut', 'Retryable', 'PreAuthorize', 'Secured') AND ((a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND a.target_id = m.method_id) OR (a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.target_id = m.owner_symbol_id)))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, http_method, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'SERVLET' , CASE m.name WHEN 'service' THEN 'ALL' ELSE upper(substring(m.name FROM 3)) END , url.path, m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('annotation', 'WebServlet') , a.file_id, m.line_start FROM analysis_annotation a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = a.revision_id AND m.owner_symbol_id = a.target_id AND m.name IN ('doGet', 'doPost', 'doPut', 'doDelete', 'doHead', 'doOptions', 'service') CROSS JOIN LATERAL AS url(path) WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.annotation_name = 'WebServlet'
mapper.select: SELECT method_id AS "methodId", name AS "name", line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId} AND name IN ('doGet', 'doPost', 'doPut', 'doDelete', 'doHead', 'doOptions', 'service') AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY line_start
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, http_method, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{endpointType}, #{httpMethod}, #{path}, #{symbolId}, #{methodId} , CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_resource (revision_id, resource_type, name, location, value, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{resourceType}, #{name}, #{location}, #{value} , CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, symbol_id, method_id, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'MAIN', m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id, m.file_id, m.line_start FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.name = 'main' AND m.is_static AND m.visibility = 'public' AND m.signature IN ('main(String[])', 'main(String...)', 'main(java.lang.String[])', 'main(java.lang.String...)')

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.method_id) #{revisionId}, 'THREAD', m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('super', r.to_external) , m.file_id, m.line_start FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = r.revision_id AND m.owner_symbol_id = r.from_id AND m.param_count = 0 AND NOT m.is_synthetic AND ((m.name = 'run' AND r.to_external IN ('java.lang.Runnable', 'java.lang.Thread', 'java.util.TimerTask')) OR (m.name = 'call' AND r.to_external = 'java.util.concurrent.Callable')) WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS') ORDER BY m.method_id

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, path, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'JSP' , '/' || regexp_replace(f.path, '^(.*/)?(webapp|WebContent|WebRoot)/', '') , f.file_id, 1 FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.language = 'JSP' AND f.path !~ '(^|/)WEB-INF/'
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_symbol s SET layer = #{layer}, layer_confidence = 'HIGH' WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = s.revision_id AND a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.target_id = s.symbol_id AND a.annotation_name IN #{name})

UPDATE analysis_symbol s SET layer = #{layer}, layer_confidence = 'MEDIUM' WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = s.revision_id AND r.from_id = s.symbol_id AND r.relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS') AND r.to_external IN #{name})

UPDATE analysis_symbol s SET layer = #{layer}, layer_confidence = 'LOW' WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer IS NULL AND s.kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' AND s.properties_json->>'synthetic' IS NULL AND s.simple_name ~ #{pattern}
mapper.select: SELECT endpoint_type AS "endpointType", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_endpoint WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY endpoint_type ORDER BY endpoint_type

SELECT COALESCE(layer, '(없음)') AS "layer" , COALESCE(layer_confidence, '') AS "confidence" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' GROUP BY layer, layer_confidence ORDER BY layer, layer_confidence

SELECT e.endpoint_id AS "endpointId" , e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , e.http_method AS "httpMethod" , e.path AS "path" , s.fqn AS "type" , s.layer AS "layer" , e.method_id AS "methodId" , m.signature AS "signature" , e.properties_json::text AS "properties" , f.path AS "file" , e.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_endpoint e JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = e.file_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = e.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = e.symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id
ORDER BY e.endpoint_type, e.path, s.fqn, e.endpoint_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
